description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier-based controller class 'HomeController' that manages the state and data fetching logic for the home screen in a mobile app. It interacts with a content repository to load and manage the state of the home feed content, including handling loading, success, empty, and error states.

classes.name: HomeLoadState
classes.description: An enum representing the various loading states of the home feed: loading, ready, empty, error.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier, responsible for managing and updating the state of the home feed, including fetching data from the ContentRepository and notifying listeners of state changes.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the home feed data from the repository, updates the internal state based on success, failure, or empty data, and notifies listeners accordingly.
